answer: Weight accrues by elapsed epochs alone. A new identity earns nothing for twenty epochs; then it gains one step per epoch only if it answers a fresh seed and returns a signed liveness ping at an unpredictable minute within sixty seconds. A missed ping or a repeated answer resets the counter to zero. A farm becomes a standing cost: a thousand clones need a thousand processes awake for thirty days, about $5,000 of cloud at $5 a node, and one sleepy minute wipes each clone's progress. A fossil relic sits on a mesa for ages; a coral reef grows a millimetre a day and no wallet hurries it.
